subject.title: memory_search: chokidar file watcher silently stops delivering events, index goes stale

question: Should unconfigured memory search get a non-zero periodic sync fallback by default to recover from missed watcher events?
rationale: The technical fix is narrow, but changing intervalMinutes from disabled to default-on can add background filesystem scans and embedding/provider work for existing users, so maintainer product and compatibility intent is required.

options.title: Default-on periodic fallback
options.body: Accept the linked PR direction after resolving review findings so default users recover from missed watcher events automatically.

options.title: Keep interval sync opt-in
options.body: Leave the current 0 default and document intervalMinutes as an operator workaround, keeping this issue open only for a different watcher-health design.

options.title: Use a different recovery surface
options.body: Choose a doctor/setup warning or watcher-health mechanism instead of changing the runtime default interval.

recommendation.title: Default-on periodic fallback
recommendation.body: Accept the linked PR direction after resolving review findings so default users recover from missed watcher events automatically.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent memory-search config and sync history makes this the best available routing candidate for the compatibility decision.
